package main

import (
 "bytes"
 "encoding/hex"
 "encoding/json"
 "fmt"
 "io"
 "runtime"

 "github.com/tink-crypto/tink-go/v2/streamingaead/subtle"
)

type Vector struct {
 Name string `json:"name"`
 Key string `json:"key"`
 AAD string `json:"aad"`
 Plaintext string `json:"plaintext"`
 Ciphertext string `json:"ciphertext"`
 SegmentBytes int `json:"segmentBytes"`
 DerivedKeyBytes int `json:"derivedKeyBytes"`
}

func main() {
 var vectors []Vector
 key := make([]byte, 32)
 for i := range key { key[i] = byte(i) }
 aad := []byte("opfs-tink-interop-v1")
 for _, profile := range []struct{ derived, segment int; lengths []int }{
  {16, 64, []int{0,1,24,25,72,73,173}},
  {32, 128, []int{0,1,72,73,184,185,409}},
 } {
  for _, length := range profile.lengths {
   pt := make([]byte, length)
   for i := range pt { pt[i] = byte(i*13 + length) }
   primitive, err := subtle.NewAESGCMHKDF(key, "SHA256", profile.derived, profile.segment, 0)
   if err != nil { panic(err) }
   var out bytes.Buffer
   writer, err := primitive.NewEncryptingWriter(&out, aad)
   if err != nil { panic(err) }
   if _, err := writer.Write(pt); err != nil { panic(err) }
   if err := writer.Close(); err != nil { panic(err) }
   ct := out.Bytes()
   reader, err := primitive.NewDecryptingReader(bytes.NewReader(ct), aad)
   if err != nil { panic(err) }
   got, err := io.ReadAll(reader)
   if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(got, pt) { panic("official Tink roundtrip failed") }
   vectors = append(vectors, Vector{fmt.Sprintf("aes%d-segment%d-length%d", profile.derived*8, profile.segment, length), hex.EncodeToString(key), hex.EncodeToString(aad), hex.EncodeToString(pt), hex.EncodeToString(ct), profile.segment, profile.derived})
  }
 }
 result := struct{
  Producer string `json:"producer"`
  Go string `json:"go"`
  Profile string `json:"profile"`
  Vectors []Vector `json:"vectors"`
 }{"github.com/tink-crypto/tink-go/v2 v2.9.0", runtime.Version(), "AES-GCM-HKDF SHA256, firstSegmentOffset=0, raw ciphertext", vectors}
 encoded, err := json.MarshalIndent(result,"","  ")
 if err != nil { panic(err) }
 fmt.Println(string(encoded))
}
